svg.text: Protagonist: unmasked faces and silhouette, refined
From the faces and silhouettes Orb liked. Top: today (the close-up engine's unmasked face). Below: refined. Neutral, hurt and the signature expression. Right: the silhouette today and two small
options. Working labels, pending Legal review.
Silhouette at fight size: today, then two options (colour, then flat black at 90 px)
The tuft grows into a long swept ribbon
that trails and hooks, and the belt knot
gets bigger: a clearer wind line.
The fists and shoulders swell into big
solid plated masses, dark like his tunic
Heavier lids and an angled brow so the eyes are determined, not wide; a swept tuft along the crown that sweeps back (his
hair has a direction, and never curls on the forehead); the temple arc kept.
